method: built-in imagegen edits; no raster postprocessing

restored.prompt: Edit this exact Starfall world-map painting into its production RESTORED state. Preserve the exact portrait 1024×1536 canvas, camera, composition, all twelve island positions and silhouettes, bridges and route geometry, starry background, existing painted material/detail style, STARFALL title/subtitle and Murk in the upper left. Remove every numbered circular badge (01 through 12) completely, painting the actual scenery/background seamlessly into their former pixels. Remove the bottom '12 LOCATION CONCEPT • NOT GAMEPLAY' caption and its decorative horizontal rule/star, replacing only that footer area with continuing night clouds/stars. Keep the artwork luminous, warm, repaired and welcoming as shown. All twelve places remain, with the same sizes and exact positions. Do not add any UI, symbols, labels, pins, buttons, rings, big numbers, alien creatures or helper characters. Existing gold star paths can remain in this restored painting. This will be registered pixel-for-pixel with a damaged-state variant later, so do not move, resize, reframe, crop, restage or redesign anything beyond the specified removal. Return only the complete painted map.

damaged.prompt: Edit the provided production Starfall map into its DAMAGED, UNRESTORED state, perfectly registered with the reference. Keep the exact 1024×1536 canvas, camera, every island's position, size, outer rock silhouette, and every bridge/route footprint; keep the identical starfield, title/subtitle and upper-left Murk. Repaint only the twelve places and their connecting paths as having lost their starlight. This is real painted damage, not a dark filter: bottom-left Lantern Landing has a tilted mast and cold unlit glass lantern, worn dock; bottom-middle Ribbon Crossing has slack faded cloth with a broken middle seam; bottom-right Kite Harbor has folded drooping sails and grounded boats. Next row right Seed Moon has a small tightly curled dry seed, no bright leaf canopy; middle Silver Pools has dry bowls, a cracked silent arch and no flowing water; left Frostfruit Orchard has dark opaque fruit and bare frosted branches. Next row left Sunwheel Mill has still bent/disconnected vanes and cold windows; middle Bell Choir has dull misaligned hanging chimes; right Starferry Station has a folded canopy, dark platform and grounded ferry. Top row right Aurora Falls has a faint motionless drained curtain and damaged arch; middle Petal Beacon has CLOSED petals around an unlit lens; left Hollow Crown is cracked and empty with cold shards, no glowing reservoir. All route lights and connecting stars are out; retain faint broken trails so the route can gradually be discovered. Use dusky indigo, dusty lavender and desaturated stone, detailed readable silhouettes and faint moonlit edges. Mysterious, gentle, storybook sadness, not horror; readable rather than pitch black. Retain clouds and stars around each island almost pixel-for-pixel so local restored regions can be composited with no visible seams. Do not change the overall exposure of the background or the title. Do not add text, number badges, padlock icons, UI borders, creatures, extra islands or new architecture. Keep all landmarks at their exact coordinates, even where damaged. Only output the full damaged painting.
